title: Understanding MSE on Test Data
text: When you add a new feature, especially a transformation like a square of an existing feature, it can affect the model's ability to generalize. Consider how this might lead to overfitting or underfitting.

title: Model Complexity and Test MSE
text: Increasing model complexity can lead to overfitting, where the model performs well on training data but poorly on test data. Think about how this affects the MSE on held-out test data.
